# Onboard a contributor

`Process: prc-rehearsal-states-a-method` `ACTIVE`

`last-rehearsed` states a `method`, which belongs to a runbook, so `rehearsal-states-no-method` reports it. `on-change`
gives `staleness` no window, so the date reports nothing.

## When to use this

When somebody new is to commit to the repository.

## Prerequisites

An account the contributor has signed in with.

## Steps

1. Add the account to the contributors team.
2. Send the contributing guide.

## Verification

The account appears in the team, and can open a pull request.

## If it goes wrong

Remove the account from the team.
